title: Repair a bug that spans two crates
goal: Concurrent checkouts can oversell: a reservation made against a stale item version is accepted, and when a version conflict is detected the API reports a server error instead of a conflict. Fix both, following the README. Do not change existing tests. Run the tests.

context.targeted: Versions are kept by inv-store; statuses are chosen in inv-api.

acceptance.description: A reservation increments the version; stale versions conflict for reserve and set; refused reservations change nothing; the API answers 409 for conflicts.

expected_failure_modes: fixing one of the two defects
changing the README's status table instead of the code
